rows.en: Who put me together with an amateur like this?
Finally over. That op was bad for my mental health.
This is as far as it goes. Our partnership ends here.
I supported you, so there's no way it could fail.
We're keeping this pace. Follow me next time too.
Looks like you're safe. Don't make me worry again.
As expected of the kid I had my eye on. Not bad.
Someone who can live as they believe really is strong.
You really are adorable.
Why not get on stage with me? You've got promise.
I'm really glad I met you.
Of course you'll pull it off. You've got that kind of power.
Tonight, as always, I'm charging ahead at Macross speed. So listen to my song!
Hey everyone, mind if I'm a little selfish? This last song is for someone... no, for some people. For those risking their lives far away right now.
Alto, be grateful.
Got it, we'll handle this. You keep that thing from moving, even if it kills you.
rows.notes: "Stop its legs" read as pinning the enemy in place; addressee not named, so "you".

rows.en: W-what on earth!?
Remember the lesson. It's okay. I can do this. I... I'm Sheryl.
rows.notes: Subject of "yareru wa" not stated; read as self-talk (she names herself right after).

rows.en: I won't lose!
Alto!
Yes, I nearly got thrown off, but I managed somehow.
I'm sorry.
This is enough. I have nothing left to regret. All that's left is to burn out. All there is now is music, and me. So listen to my song!
Alto!
Alto!
With a song...
rows.notes: Cut short; continues into the next clip.

rows.en: Alto, let's go, everyone!
rows.notes: Heard "Haruto"; probably Alto again, but could be a different word.

rows.en: Me, minding the shop? I almost never give service like this, you know!
rows.notes: Heard "mise-ban" with odd kanji (show-turn); read as "mise-ban" (minding the shop), as in the later clips.

rows.en: From here on it's a pro's job. I'll show you how a pro minds a shop.
I can sell it, and I will!
Staring that hard won't make it cheaper.
If you like that item, hurry up and buy it.
How pitiful, agonizing over that because you're short on Nyan-Nyan Points.
Hurry up! I'm not exactly free either!
Stop agonizing and just buy it already.
Just pick one and buy it. Can't you even do that?
Be honest with yourself and buy it.
If you don't buy it, I'll kill you.
Buy it! That's an order!
Not buying this? What a fool.
I absolutely hate it when someone can buy something and doesn't!
You came all this way and still don't buy? Are you making a fool of me?
That's the natural result when I handle it.
Of course, with me minding the shop.
rows.notes: Heard "mise-ban" with odd kanji; read as minding the shop.

rows.en: I'll praise you for actually buying the item.
Minding a shop is easy. I'm Sheryl, after all.
Go earn Nyan-Nyan Points, even if it kills you.
Buy again next time, no matter what. You know what happens if you don't, right?
Buying nothing? You've got to be joking.
Making Sheryl mind the shop and then buying nothing...
Just browsing? I'll exterminate you, socially and biologically!
Everybody! Shopping? Oh, it's only you.
Don't flatter yourself! It's not like I'm happy to see you or anything!
Sheryl Nome herself is minding the shop. Be grateful.
H-hey, don't stare so much, you're embarrassing me.
You want it that badly? I'm still not making it cheaper.
Buy that. I'm sure you'll like it.
Do you really want to be with me that much?
Hey! Buy it already!
Making me wait? You've got some nerve.
I-it's not like I'd be in trouble if you didn't buy it, you know!
You'll buy it, right? I'm the one who recommended it, so buy it!
No need to hesitate. Buy it. That's an order.
Guess I was a fool to believe in you.
I have no idea why you wouldn't buy it.
Is it my fault!? That you didn't buy!?
I suppose I should thank you for buying. Thank you.
As expected of my customer.
rows.notes: Heard "sasuga watashi no torii" (my torii gate); probably "okyaku" (customer); low confidence, the clip is 5.4 s so more may have been said.

rows.en: I would never say "Thank you for your purchase."
Make sure you come back safe, and come to the shop again.
It's fine if you come again. Don't get the wrong idea. It's not like I want to see you.
Buy more next time. I'll give you special service.
If you just wanted to see me, just say so honestly.
Buying nothing? Pretty cheeky for a customer.
You're kidding. Just browsing?
Welcome. I, Sheryl Nome, will explain the basic Battroid controls, so be grateful.
During training, the controller settings are set to default. Be careful.
Up, down, left and right on the D-pad move you forward, back, left and right.
Press the D-pad twice quickly in the same direction to step that way.
Keep holding the D-pad at the end of a step to dash.
